evaluation_components.notes: Date and time will be announced

makeup_policy: Make-up request for the mid-semester examination is to be submitted 7 days in advance of the exam (or within 72 hrs. in case of medical emergency). For comprehensive examination the request is often made to AUGSD. There is no makeup for the project presentations. However, students can mutually change the dates with permission from I/C. It is mandatory to submit the necessary supporting documents (such as: listed below) along with make-up request: o Letter of invitation/selection for a national/international event where the applicant is representing BITS Pilani. o Proof of hospitalization, medical certificate, prescription, medicine purchase bill, etc.
